summary: John's maternal 2nd great-grandmother per the tree; wife of Giovanni Cognetta.
bio: Tree: Mariarosa C. Lamanna (b. 1863), wife of Giovanni Cognetta. Round 1: Lamanna is a widespread surname; Calabrian clusters at Melissa, Carpanzano, Tiriolo and Parenti (paese.app). A Maria Rosa Lamanna b. 1865 at Casino (now Castelsilano) is a DIFFERENT woman - she married a Girimonte (Girimonti research p306). Round 3 confirmed (index) that Lamanna occurs in Dasà in 1854-55, which supports the tree's Dasà connections.
sources: Girimonti research p306 (different Maria Rosa Lamanna): https://girimonti.circolocalabrese.org/research/p306.htm
openQuestions: Her birth and marriage acts (Dasà civil registers; 1862-1910 births not on Antenati)
